halfLife.notes: Once-daily dosing. Steady state in 7 days. Must be taken with food (≥350 kcal) — bioavailability increases 2–3× with food. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.name: ID-14283 (norsulpiride analogue)
activeMetabolite.notes: Active metabolite ID-14283 contributes marginally to activity; not considered clinically dominant. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (ketoconazole, clarithromycin, ritonavir) markedly raise lurasidone levels — halve dose or avoid. Strong CYP3A4 inducers (carbamazepine, rifampicin) reduce levels — may need dose increase. Avoid co-prescription with grapefruit juice. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

metabolicRisk.notes: One of the most metabolically neutral SGAs — minimal weight gain, no significant glucose or lipid dysregulation in clinical trials. Favourable profile for patients with metabolic syndrome. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: MUST be taken with food (at least 350 kcal) — absorption doubles with food. Take with the main meal. Tablets should not be crushed. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
specialConsiderations: MANDATORY FOOD REQUIREMENT: Take with ≥350 kcal meal. Inadequate food intake results in significantly lower drug exposure and potential treatment failure.
Also licensed for bipolar depression — a differentiating feature among SGAs.
CYP3A4 substrate — check for inducers/inhibitors at initiation and when other medications change.
Akathisia is the main dose-limiting side effect — counsel early.
Useful for patients where metabolic neutrality is critical (diabetes, obesity, dyslipidaemia).
